trigger.Name: PlayerVehAndRandom
trigger.script:
GetPlayerVehicle():SetNameFromScript("PlayerOwnCar") GetPlayerVehicle():SetGamePositionOnGround( CVector(1831.811, 375.276, 1834.494)) CapturePlayerVehicle() AddPlayerVehicle("ArcadeScout02") GetPlayerVehicle():SetPosition( CVector(2603.933, 322.643, 1698.991)) GetPlayerVehicle():SetRotation(Quaternion(0.003, -1.000, -0.003, 0.024)) GetPlayerVehicle():setImmortalMode(1) GetPlayerVehicle():SetSkin(random(0,2)) GetPlayerVehicle():SetCustomLinearVelocity(50)
TeamCreate("Enemy1",1002,CVector(2570.735, 322.577, 1690.726),{"ArcadeScout02"}) TeamCreate("Enemy2",1002,CVector(2657.204, 322.829, 1683.914),{"ArcadeScout02"}) TeamCreate("Enemy3",1002,CVector(2694.642, 322.684, 1690.257),{"ArcadeScout02"}) TeamCreate("Enemy4",1002,CVector(2706.522, 322.697, 1664.335),{"ArcadeScout02"}) TeamCreate("Enemy5",1002,CVector(2687.767, 322.676, 1594.142),{"ArcadeScout02"}) TeamCreate("Enemy6",1002,CVector(2614.555, 322.678, 1601.007),{"ArcadeScout02"}) g_Console:InputLine '/ai_clash_coeff 0' g_Console:InputLine '/ai_location_debug 1' TActivate("PlayerDie") AllowSave(0) local coord = getObj("locZero"):GetPosition() coord.x = coord.x + random(100) coord.z = coord.z + random(100) coord.x = coord.x - random(100) coord.z = coord.z - random(100) getObj("locbattle8"):SetPosition(CVector(coord))

trigger.Name: Box
trigger.script: PlayCustomMusic("TUNER") SpawnMessageBox("1") trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: VictoryTr
trigger.script: SpawnMessageBox("2") AddPlayerMoney(50000) CapturePlayerVehicle() local ownplvh = getObj("PlayerOwnCar") g_Player:AddChild(ownplvh) PassToMap("r4m1", "TheKazif_enter") StopPlayingCustomMusic() local diff = GetDifficultyLevel() if diff == 0 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.000015") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 1.5") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 2") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") elseif diff == 1 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.000015") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") elseif diff == 2 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.003") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 0.75") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") end g_Console:InputLine '/ai_location_debug 0' AllowSave(1) GetPlayerVehicle():SetCustomControlEnabled(0) trigger:Deactivate()

trigger.Name: PlayerDie
trigger.script: if 2 > GetPlayerVehicle():GetHealth() then SpawnMessageBox("3") AddPlayerMoney(5000) CapturePlayerVehicle() local ownplvh = getObj("PlayerOwnCar") g_Player:AddChild(ownplvh) PassToMap("r4m1", "TheKazif_enter") local diff = GetDifficultyLevel() if diff == 0 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.000015") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 1.5") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 2") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") elseif diff == 1 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.000015") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") elseif diff == 2 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.003") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 0.75") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") end g_Console:InputLine '/ai_location_debug 0' StopPlayingCustomMusic() AllowSave(1) GetPlayerVehicle():SetCustomControlEnabled(0) trigger:Deactivate() end

trigger.Name: ScriptTimerLoc8

trigger.Name: ScriptPassLoc8
trigger.script:
local run = GetEntityByName("locbattle8") local pl = GetPlayerVehicle() local len
if run then len = Dist(pl, run)
if (len > 50) then GetPlayerVehicle():AddModifier("HP","= 0") end end
local coord = getObj("locZero"):GetPosition() coord.x = coord.x + random(100) coord.z = coord.z + random(100) coord.x = coord.x - random(100) coord.z = coord.z - random(100) getObj("locbattle7"):SetPosition(CVector(coord)) getObj("locbattle8"):Remove() TActivate("ScriptTimerLoc7")
trigger:Deactivate()
